prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A solitary figure stands at the edge of a dark, tranquil shoreline at night, gazing out over gently rippling waves. The person is silhouetted in the foreground, their features obscured by shadow, creating a sense of mystery and introspection. Stretching out over the water are a series of large, glowing, geometric frames—perfectly square, luminous white portals—receding into the distance and drawing the viewer’s eye toward the horizon. The illuminated frames cast a soft, ethereal glow on the surface of the ocean, contrasting starkly with the deep blues and blacks of the night scene. Above, a clear sky is dotted with faint stars, adding to the dreamlike, surreal atmosphere. The overall composition is minimalist and cinematic, with a strong sense of depth and symmetry. The color palette is dominated by cool tones—navy, indigo, and white—while the lighting is low and moody, emphasizing the otherworldly quality of the glowing frames. The camera angle is straight-on, at eye level with the figure, enhancing the immersive, contemplative mood of the scene.
